build_features_schema: build a Features object with Value and ClassLabel fields to define a dataset schema
create_classlabel_mapping: create a ClassLabel feature with named classes for string to integer label conversion
cast_tensors_to_python: cast numpy pytorch or tensorflow tensors to native python lists recursively
convert_arrow_to_features: convert a pyarrow DataType to an equivalent datasets FeatureType using generate_from_arrow_type
encode_decode_examples: encode or decode dataset examples using Features encode_example and decode_example methods
